name: builds the shortest front-only palindrome for ordinary cases
test:
assert shortest_palindrome_prefix('') == ''
assert shortest_palindrome_prefix('racecar') == 'racecar'
assert shortest_palindrome_prefix('aab') == 'baab'
assert shortest_palindrome_prefix('wxyz') == 'zyxwxyz'
assert shortest_palindrome_prefix('aacecaaa') == 'aaacecaaa'

name: uses a sentinel that cannot collide with input characters
input: an already-palindromic string containing a conventional KMP separator

name: handles a long string whose longest palindromic prefix is one character
input: one a followed by many b characters
test:
suffix = 'b' * 20000
s = 'a' + suffix
assert shortest_palindrome_prefix(s) == suffix + s
